column1: # Isaac can buy bread for Altin.

column3:
The flood ruined our grain.
Twelve families have no
food left.{page_break}Could you spare 250 coins
to buy them bread?{end_now}
Thank you. The children\nwill eat tonight.{end_wait}
I understand. You've\ngiven us your time already.\nI'll ask someone else.{end_wait}
The bread is gone already.\nEvery family got a share.\nThank you again.{end_wait}
You have nothing to spare?\nThen keep what you have.\nYou'll need it on the road.{end_wait}
Buy what they need.\nDon't tell them who paid.{end_wait}
